duat_passage.label: Before the hall
duat_passage.help: Proper burial: after 70 days of embalming the soul sets out for the Hall of Two Truths; the judgment can't be claimed before then. An infant or early death is not judged and goes straight to the Field of Reeds. The nameless do not enter the underworld, and an improper burial (body not intact, no spells) cannot complete the journey: both judgments stay held.

baptism.label: Baptism
baptism.help: Unbaptised or born before Christ, with no heavier sin: the first circle, Limbo (not a punishment). A heavier sin decides instead. A baptised soul never lands in Limbo.

denied_immortality.label: Denied the soul's immortality
denied_immortality.help: Held in life that the soul dies with the body (the Epicureans, Inf. X): when condemned, the sixth circle (heresy), unless a cited sin lies deeper. Not blasphemy, which is the seventh circle.

neutral_in_life.label: Neutral in life
neutral_in_life.help: Lived neither for good nor for evil, taking no side (Inf. III): when condemned with no deeper circle cited, the vestibule of hell, outside the nine circles.

ferry_passage.label: The crossing
ferry_passage.help: Charon ferries only the buried who can pay. The unburied and those without a fare wait on the bank of Acheron and their judgment can't be claimed; record “Buried, fare paid” and the case can be heard. The unburied also cross once a hundred years have passed since death (Virgil); those without a fare do not.

sin_gravity.label: Mortal / venial
sin_gravity.help: An unrepented mortal sin can only be condemned (hell). Venial sins and absolved mortal sins can't be sent to hell; they are purged in purgatory. Unclassified deeds are not checked.
